hostTools.label: macOS
hostTools.code: brew install python uv cmake ninja git

hostTools.label: Linux
hostTools.code:
# Debian and Ubuntu
sudo apt update
sudo apt install python3 python3-pip cmake ninja-build git

# Fedora
sudo dnf install python3 python3-pip cmake ninja-build git

# uv, from the official installer, on either
curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh

hostTools.label: Windows
hostTools.code: winget install Python.Python.3.12 astral-sh.uv Kitware.CMake Ninja-build.Ninja Git.Git
hostTools._note: helia-ui's CodeLanguage union has no PowerShell member, so the Windows tabs stay unhighlighted rather than being mislabeled as another shell.

toolchain.label: Linux
toolchain.code:
# Download the arm-none-eabi Linux build from
# https://developer.arm.com/downloads/-/arm-gnu-toolchain-downloads
# then extract it somewhere stable and put its bin/ on PATH.
echo 'export PATH="/opt/arm-gnu-toolchain/bin:$PATH"' >> ~/.bashrc
source ~/.bashrc
arm-none-eabi-gcc --version

toolchain.label: Windows
toolchain.code:
# Run the official Arm GNU Toolchain installer from
# https://developer.arm.com/downloads/-/arm-gnu-toolchain-downloads
# and tick "Add path to environment variable" on the last page.
# Open a new terminal so the updated PATH is picked up, then:
arm-none-eabi-gcc --version

probe.label: Linux
probe.code:
# Download the .deb or .rpm J-Link Software and Documentation Pack from
# https://www.segger.com/downloads/jlink/ and install the downloaded file with
# your package manager, for example:
sudo apt install ./<downloaded-jlink-package>.deb
